title: Workspace cycling within channel (Ctrl+Tab?)
description: Eventually need to cycle through workspaces within a channel. Ctrl+Tab feels nice but probably impossible in terminals. Need to find workable alternative.

title: Channel activity indicators (basic)
description: Claude Code supports activity bells - hook into that as starting point. Foundation for complex activity indication later (chat, mentions, agent approval, shell bell). Start simple, iterate.

title: Activity indicators: complex cases
description: Beyond basic bells: chat activity, @mentions, agent stalled/needs-approval, workspace shell bell. Multiple indicator types, likely requires iteration. Depends on basic activity indicators (bz-18u).

title: Dynamic channel management
description: Channels need to be dynamically mutable (add/remove/rename). Probably backed by a bz state file in XDG_STATE_HOME. Currently hardcoded in bin/bz.

title: Architecture: zellij vs roll-own TUI
description: Build on zellij (get pty stuff 'free', pay interop costs) vs roll own TUI. How hard is DIY pty handling? Rust/zig/go libs? If no send-keys, no splits, one buffer at a time... maybe simpler than 'write your own tmux'? Needs investigation.

title: Config file: theming, sidebar width, colors
description: ~/.config/bz.conf or toml. Configurable: colors, sidebar width, etc. Foundation for user customization.

title: Config file: keybinds
description: Keybinds should be configurable via config file rather than hardcoded. Related to theming config (bz-1uk).

title: Testing strategy
description: What does testing look like for a TUI like this? Snapshot testing? Integration tests driving tmux? Related to agent self-QA (bz-6ki).

title: Sidebar: active channel indicator styling
description: Current: white=active, grey=inactive. Problem: white reads as 'unreads but not mentions' (Slack mental model). Proposed: grey background (full-width, not just behind text) for active channel.

title: Decouple from bash scripts
description: Current implementation uses bash for picker, sidebar, help. Eventually need to move to something more robust. Related to broader architecture decisions.

title: Rust TUI rewrite
description:
Replace bash+zellij+tmux stack with custom ratatui TUI. Core motivation: activity detection is impossible with zellij (no API for pane output events). Custom PTY handling gives us full control over the UX.

Key libraries: ratatui, portable-pty, vt100

See docs/architecture-research.md for full analysis.

title: M1: Hello PTY
description:
Proof of concept: ratatui app that spawns one PTY child process and renders its output.

Goals:
- Validate portable-pty + vt100 + ratatui work together
- Basic input routing (keystrokes reach the shell)
- Resize handling

Done when: can spawn bash, run ls, see colored output, type commands.

title: M2: Multi-PTY with tabs
description:
Multiple PTY sessions with tab-based switching.

Goals:
- Spawn multiple PTY children
- Tab bar or minimal UI showing available sessions
- Switch focus between them
- Each maintains independent state

Done when: can have 3+ shells, switch between them, each remembers scrollback.

title: M3: Activity detection
description:
The proof point for the whole rewrite. Detect when unfocused PTYs have new output.

Goals:
- Track 'has unread output' per PTY
- Visual indicator in tab bar (bold, dot, etc.)
- Clear indicator when tab is focused
- Bonus: detect terminal bell (\x07)

Done when: run 'sleep 5 && echo done' in background tab, see activity indicator appear.

title: M4: Sidebar + channel model
description:
Replace tab bar with bz's sidebar-based channel navigation.

Goals:
- Sidebar pane showing channel list
- Channel = named PTY session
- Cmd+K / Ctrl+K picker for quick switching
- Activity indicators in sidebar
- Current channel highlighted

Done when: looks like the current bz sidebar but running natively.

title: M5: Floating panes
description:
Floating pane support for picker, help, and mobile hamburger menu.

Goals:
- Render floating pane over main content
- Dismiss on Esc or selection
- Channel picker as floating pane
- Foundation for mobile-friendly hamburger menu

Done when: Ctrl+K opens floating picker, selection switches channel and closes picker.

title: M6: Polish pass
description:
UX polish before declaring MVP complete.

Goals:
- Smooth resize behavior
- Proper terminal emulation edge cases (test with Claude Code, iamb, vim)
- Error handling (PTY crashes, etc.)
- Config file for channels (instead of hardcoded)
- Keybind customization

Done when: daily-driveable for real work.

title: Agent self-QA: enable Claude to drive/see bz for testing
Decouple from tmux: persistent workspaces
description: A channel will have: chat, optional user workspace, zero+ agent workspaces. These should persist even if bz dies (like tmux detach). Currently using tmux sessions for this - need to think about persistence model.

title: UX: rethink channel state indicators
description:
Current approach may have inverted semantics vs Slack mental model (white = unread there).

Ideas to explore:
- Grey/white = "have you visited since last stdout"
- Spinner animation = work in progress
- Red dot = actual notification needing action
- Or other visual language that's more intuitive

Need to think through what states actually matter and how to communicate them clearly.

title: Matrix integration
description: Figure out Matrix integration sooner rather than later. Potentially support /bz <completions> in chat, e.g. '/bz add <agent>'. Chat is core to the multi-agent coordination vision.

title: Picker: visual polish
description:
Clean up the picker UI:

- Remove filename header
- Remove "PIN [ ]" text  
- Grey background instead of black
- Inset border by 1 character
- Reduce height to ~6 lines
- Disable picker shortcut while picker is active (prevent re-triggering)

title: Sidebar: version header at top
description: Proper top header like 'bz v0.1.0' without padding. Thinking tmux-style header treatment.

title: Help keybind: Ctrl+/ alternative for terminal compatibility
description: Ctrl+/ doesn't work over Termius (and likely other terminals). Need a more universal keybind alternative. Could also be part of configurable keybinds.

title: Switcher: MRU sorting with smart default selection
description: Stealing from Slack's ergonomics: Sort channels by MRU at top, second option selected by default (since most recent = current). Result: Ctrl+k <enter> trivially toggles to previous channel. May keep fzf or explore alternatives.
close_reason: Implemented MRU sorting with history tracking, # prefix for channel names, load:down for consistent second-item selection

title: Shipping: bundling dependencies (zellij, fzf)
description: How does bz ship and with what dependencies? Bundle zellij and fzf? Keep those deps at all? Related to broader architecture decisions about rolling own TUI.
